Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.inactivity

Class InactiveAccountDetector

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.inactivity.InactiveAccountDetector
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="account.inactivity", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class InactiveAccountDetector extends Object
Nightly job that flags accounts empty for longer than the threshold and clears accounts that no longer are. Each run then publishes an InactivityCheckedEvent, delivered after it commits, which InactiveAccountNotifier uses to email the clients of newly flagged accounts.

  • Method Details

    • detect

      @Scheduled(cron="${account.inactivity.cron:0 0 2 * * *}", zone="UTC") @Transactional public void detect()
      Runs the inactivity check: flags accounts that have been empty for at least the threshold, clears the flag (and the notification record) on accounts that are no longer empty, then publishes an InactivityCheckedEvent. Scheduled at 02:00 UTC by default.
